added_failures_note: The reviewed run is a measurement prototype and declares no suite gate: its manifest carries baseline_suite and after_suite absent, so no base and head suite arm exists to compare and no failure ids are derivable; added_failure_count is 0 with an empty id list.

findings.text: follow-on: the ruling's part (b) asked to route the nine stencil Hessians and the point evaluation through one batched call 'so the kernel body appears once'. The delivered batched_field batches the plasma/reference source pair instead, leaving five packed-kernel sites and three Hessian sites - half the native counts, not one. The report states this plainly (a 'source-term sharing inside each stage, not one global kernel invocation'), and read.py shows the stencil offsets already run through a single lax.map body, so batching the offsets alone is a no-op; but the brief's literal single-body target is not met and the achieved reduction is source-term sharing, not kernel collapse.

follow-on: the batched-field equivalence is asserted only on the limited state at 132 and 550 cells. batched_field rewrites TotalField.value/evaluate (the total-minus-reference composition) - the exact path the null-census, curvature and wall-search stages run through - yet the diverted single-null state, where saddle curvature is nonzero and the read exercises the saddle machinery, is never compared. All reported identity maxima are 0.0, but the saddle curvature and cubic tensors are zero on the limited case, so the equality is on the quantities the case does not generate; the report itself says it 'is not a diverted-saddle accuracy qualification'. The batching's equivalence on the read's own target geometry is therefore unmeasured.

follow-on: the four rows of job 1283105 ran as both natives first, then both batched, so the ~48% cold-wall reduction (932.887760371 -> 477.653021518 s at 132; 854.907227011 -> 449.409065152 s at 550) carries a machine-state/ordering confound. Within-rung CPU affinity is matched (60/60 and 61/61), and the executable shrink (36.45M -> 20.06M bytes) independently corroborates a real program reduction, so the conclusion stands; but an interleaved or repeated run would remove the confound - the same objection the plan's own reference raised against three sequential measurements.

The two quantities are close but not the same measurement, so the reported share mixes a standalone helper trace with the read's own graph.

follow-on for the coordinator: the node's original done-when named the 2,000-cell rung, the diverted single-null axis/X-point positions with saddle-neighbourhood membership error and per-quantity curvature differences, and the three-spacing curvature sensitivity. The ruling replaced the done-when with the batching study and the report lists all three under 'Remaining, explicitly unmeasured'; none is delivered and all three belong to a follow-on node.
